dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good morning. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to open an account, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈoʊpən ən əˈkaʊnt, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. Can I see your ID card?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. kən aɪ ˈsiː jʊr ˌaɪˈdiː ˌkɑːrd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks. Now please fill out this form.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈnaʊ ˈpliːz ˌfɪl ˈaʊt ðɪs ˈfɔːrm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is it OK if I fill it out in Thai?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ ɪf aɪ ˈfɪl ɪt ˈaʊt ɪn ˈtaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. And please write your address here.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ənd ˈpliːz ˈraɪt jʊr ˈædrɛs ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'd like to get a bank card, too.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈɡɛt ə ˈbæŋk ˌkɑːrd, ˈtuː.
